company.shortDescription: Nuro is a robotics company specializing in the development of autonomous driving technologies.
company.description: ​Nuro is a robotics company specializing in the development of autonomous driving technologies for various applications, including goods delivery and passenger mobility. The company has created the Nuro Driver™, an autonomous driving system that integrates advanced software and hardware to enable Level 4 autonomous driving capabilities. This system is designed for use across multiple vehicle platforms, including passenger vehicles and delivery robots.
